name: BBC
body: DMARC reject, preloaded HSTS, and Core Web Vitals that pass for real visitors. Its robots.txt also turns away AI answer crawlers like ChatGPT search and Perplexity. GEO: 56.
lesson: Blocking AI training and blocking AI answers are separate choices. Name each crawler in robots.txt on purpose.
summary: www.bbc.com scores 79 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 16 are at risk, and 18 pass. Fix first: 5 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked.

fix.title: 5 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked
fix.evidence: OAI-SearchBot (ChatGPT search) by Disallow: /, ChatGPT-User (ChatGPT, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /, PerplexityBot (Perplexity answers) by Disallow: /, Perplexity-User (Perplexity, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /,…
fix.fix: Allow the answer bots in robots.txt. Training bots can stay blocked if that is the policy.

fix.title: 791 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 100 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme
fix.evidence: In /afrique/sitemap.xml: www.bbc.co.uk (100). The sitemap should list only URLs on https://www.bbc.com.
fix.fix: Regenerate the sitemap with the production https host.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 19 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 150 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on 18 of 19 pages analyzed.

works.title: Model-training crawlers are blocked by choice
HSTS is sent with a long max-age
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 291 ms
Language alternates point at each other
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
